text_block_list.text: While walking in front of the station, Biwa Hayahide stopped in her tracks as if she just remembered something.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —That reminds me, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember the coffee shop
I tried to introduce you to a while back?
choice_data_list: You mean that shop with the shutters closed?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm concerned that it was closed during business hours...
Would you mind if I went to check on it?

Nodding along with Biwa Hayahide's words,
we decided to go check on the shop.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The shop closes at 8:00 PM.
Normally, it should still be open—

I follow Biwa Hayahide's gaze.
There, a person who looked like the shopkeeper
was just about to pull down the shutters.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I wonder why.
âI will go and talk to them.
Biwa Hayahide ran off toward the shop, so I hurriedly decided to chase after her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. It shouldn't be closing time just yet, should it...?

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry about that. Lately, I've been
closing up the shop a little early."

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
Even if we stay open late,
customers don't really come in anyway.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No customers coming in...?

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, a big cafe run by a famous barista opened up nearby."

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since that shop opened, our customers have vanished completely.
I suppose it's about time we consider closing down..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No way...

—A cafe run by a famous barista.
That must be the shop I visited with Biwa Hayahide before.

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
We've managed to make it this far through
plenty of trial and error, though.

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
Coming up with seasonal menu items,
catering to regular customers' requests...

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Still, no matter how hard you try,
you're no match for a famous barista.

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
If someone with both talent and fame gets serious,
a plain little shop like ours doesn't stand a chance.

Whether the shopkeeper's words struck a chord or not,
Biwa Hayahide's expression clouded over.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I understand what you're saying.
However—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What I loved about this shop was its comfort,
its atmosphere, and the owner's wonderful personality.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And those must have been the result of the owner's trial and error to satisfy the customers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Then why don't we just engage in some fresh trial and error this time as well?"

Biwa Hayahide's words are filled with passion.
However—

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
It makes me happy to hear you say that much.

text_block_list.name: Café Owner
text_block_list.text:
“Still, running a shop isn't easy.
I have no choice but to be careful....”

Her passion came through clearly,
but it wasn't enough to persuade the shopkeeper...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...It's difficult in any world, isn't it?
To keep on winning, that is.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If only there were something,
anything I could do to help...

The difficulty of continuing to win. That surely
resonates with her own experiences as well.
choice_data_list: I wish that shop had some weapons too...
If it's helping with promotion, I might be able to help.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—I've got it!
That's it, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"That shop's secret weapon...!
As a regular, I'm the only one who knows what it is!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "If we tell him that, the shopkeeper might just change his mind...!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Thanks to you,
I feel like I've found what I can do!

Praying that Biwa Hayahide's feelings would reach the owner,
we headed on our way home.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right. In terms of what's realistically feasible,
that's about it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Still, doing just a bit of advertising
is only going to have limited results—"
choice_data_list: If only I had something to go on...
If only I had a lead or something...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...That's it! If we create a foothold and boost our
promotional impact, we'll have a shot at victory!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"What does that shop really need—
I've got to put all the info together once I get back!"
choice_data_list: Let me know if there's anything I can do to help.
Let me know if you need any help, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun.
I will make sure that shop survives at all costs...!

Biwa Hayahide answers,
her eyes filled with fierce determination.
